title: After Refusing to Invest in Crypto
description:
Two months since you turned down the crypto investment.
You'd heard what happened to the people who went in.
Today you looked at the chart.

choices.result_text:
It had dropped hard.
Refusing had been right.
But it was a gut call at the time, not information.

Up then down.
Declining had worked out in the end — but it was refusing to participate, not timing the exit.

title: After Talking a Friend Out of Crypto
description:
Two months since you talked your friend out of putting big money into crypto.
You'd been wondering how they were.
Today they reached out.

choices.result_text:
'Good thing I listened to you,' they said.
You remembered how they'd been annoyed when you stopped them.

You didn't gloat.
They said 'Thanks.'

title: After Winning Big at Poker
description:
Two months since the big win at the holdem table.
That feeling had stayed with you.
Today word came that there was a seat again.

choices.result_text:
You declined.
After a big win — the urge to sit back down is at its strongest.

You sat.
This time was different.

title: After Quitting Poker
description:
Two months since you decided to quit holdem.
It had come to mind sometimes.
Today one of the old regulars reached out.

choices.result_text:
You declined.
Quitting starts with not answering these messages.

You went just to watch.
You didn't sit.

title: After Chasing Losses at the Track
description:
Two months since you chased your losses and lost more.
That day was still vivid.
Today word came that the racing season was starting again.

choices.result_text:
You didn't go.
The memory of chasing the loss — stopped you this time.

You went.
'This time is different.' You had said the same thing last time.

title: After Winning Big at the Track
description:
Two months since the big win at the racetrack.
What mattered was what you'd done with the money.
Today you looked back at it.

choices.result_text:
You'd used it well.
Winfall money — leaves something when it's used for something real.

choices.text: The urge to bet again had been there
choices.result_text:
The urge had been there.
You'd put some back in.

title: After Refusing to Be a Guarantor
description:
Two months since you turned down their request to co-sign.
Things had been awkward since.
Today you heard how that person was doing.

choices.result_text:
Things hadn't gone well for them.
Refusing had been right.

Still on your mind.
But the outcome had been right.

title: After Signing as Guarantor
description:
Two months since you signed as their guarantor.
No word since.
Today a message came from the bank.

choices.result_text:
A missed payment notice.
The moment you signed — their credit became yours.

You called first.
No answer.
Being a guarantor doesn't end at signing — it has to be managed.

title: After Getting Jeonse Insurance
description:
Three months since you took out jeonse deposit insurance.
Nothing had happened since.
Today you heard about the unit next door.

choices.result_text:
The neighbor hadn't gotten insurance.
When the landlord issue came up, the difference showed.

You felt relief.
You'd thought the premium was a waste at times.

title: After Ignoring Jeonse Insurance
description:
Three months since you skipped the jeonse deposit insurance as too much hassle.
You'd figured nothing would happen.
Today the landlord suddenly got in touch.

choices.result_text:
They said returning the deposit would be difficult.
Not getting insurance — was exactly for this moment.

You moved fast to respond.
No insurance meant fighting it yourself.

title: After Refusing to Help Your Parents
description:
Two months since you turned down your parents' request for financial help.
Contact had been less frequent since.
Today a text came from your mother.

choices.result_text:
You answered.
Nothing much said.
Just a check-in.

choices.text: Still not sure how to be with them
choices.result_text:
Still felt uncomfortable.
The refusal might have been right.

title: After Confessing the Resume Lie
description:
Two months since you came clean about the resume exaggeration after joining.
You'd been watching how the team lead would treat you since.
Today they called you in separately.

choices.text: Hear what they have to say
choices.result_text:
'I appreciate you being honest with me,' they said.
Not a reprimand.
The confession had built trust.

title: After Being Honest at the Reunion
description:
Two months since you spoke honestly about where you were at the class reunion.
That night came back to you sometimes.
Today a message came from someone who'd been there.

choices.result_text:
'That was cool — the way you were just straight about it,' they said.
The honesty — had become an impression.

You answered warmly.
Being honest that night — had made this message happen.

title: After Returning the Wallet
description:
Two months since you returned the lost wallet to its owner.
You'd moved on without thinking about it.
Today something unexpected happened.

choices.result_text:
A small piece of good luck.
Whether it was connected to the wallet — impossible to say.

Just a good day.
Returning the wallet hadn't been about getting something back.

title: After Keeping the Found Money
description:
Two months since you kept the money you found.
It came to mind sometimes.
Today the same situation came up again.

choices.result_text:
You returned it this time.
The lingering guilt from last time had stayed with you.

You kept it again.
What you've done once is easier the second time.
